mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation (order_id, evaluator_id, target_user_id, score, comment) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{evaluatorId}, #{targetUserId}, #{score}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT eval_id, order_id, evaluator_id, target_user_id, score, comment, create_time FROM evaluation WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT AVG(score) FROM evaluation WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND score IS NOT NULL
